rules.title: Intake refuses by name
rules.statement: A pass begins only when every input it runs on is present: a video slot, an image slot, a reasoning slot, the audio judge slot when audio is on, accepted terms, a dated price file, a schema-valid style and schema-valid policy values. Each absent input is refused by its name before any paid call; intake is the only refusal the pipeline knows.

rules.title: Ideation derives
rules.statement: Ideation completes the brief by derivation from the idea and the style: every field carries derived, its source and its reason, and the pass proceeds on what it derived. The person speaks through the style file and the policy file before the pass and through notes after it.

rules.title: Approval is arithmetic
rules.statement: The manifest is approved by numbers: plates, keyframe candidates and takes with their full attempt pools are summed and compared against every declared ceiling; a refusal carries the limit, the spend so far and the need, and lands before any money.

rules.title: Reservation before spend
rules.statement: Every paid or metered call names the plan node it serves and holds a journaled reservation before the wire; every cost row names the reservation that preceded it.

rules.title: Attempts are counted from the policy
rules.statement: Plates, keyframe candidates, shots and faults each retry within the attempt count the policy file declares for their kind; the count used is recorded against the count allowed.

provenance.decree: creator, 2026-09: five attempts everywhere — plates, keyframe candidates, shots, faults

rules.title: Regeneration follows the declared order
rules.statement: A shot regenerates in the order the policy file declares: the same keyframe first, then a new candidate; once the order is spent its last mode repeats until the attempt count is reached.

rules.title: Chains are bounded
rules.statement: A chain is a cut-headed run of continuous joins; every chain in the plan is at most the policy's chain length, and chains are the unit the scheduler runs in parallel.

rules.title: The pass completes when a budget is exhausted
rules.statement: A shot whose attempts are spent takes the policy's exhausted-shot decision and a shot stopped by the render ceiling takes the policy's ceiling decision: promote the best take by score, or hold the best keyframe as a still for the planned seconds. Either way the timeline stays complete and the shortfall is a named finding with every attempt's score.

provenance.decree: creator, 2026-09: a pass always completes — produced, with every shortfall named

rules.title: Judge authority is policy
rules.statement: A rubric triggers regeneration only while the policy file lists it as spending; every other rubric ranks candidates and files notes as a witness.

rules.title: Promotion is earned by calibration
rules.statement: A witness rubric becomes spending exactly when its recorded agreement with the creator's notes reaches the policy's precision on at least the policy's minimum instances; the promotion is a journaled event carrying the rows that justified it.

rules.title: Recurrence invokes the critic
rules.statement: One finding signature recurring across at least the policy's minimum passes and minimum distinct ideas invokes the critic for a rule proposal; below those counts the signature accumulates in the errors database.

rules.title: Ceilings are declared
rules.statement: The policy file names every ceiling, count, concurrency and threshold the pass may use; a ceiling is a number or null, and null means the pass is bounded by attempt counts alone — declared and journaled on every record through the policy hash.

provenance.decree: creator, 2026-09: ceilings are unbounded by default — null is a declaration, never a default

rules.title: The harness decides the keyframe
rules.statement: Whether a shot starts from a generated keyframe is decided per shot from its join: the first shot and every cut shot start from a keyframe generated from the plates; a continuous shot starts from the previous take's recorded last frame. The decision and its reason are recorded on the shot.

provenance.decree: creator, 2026-09: the harness decides whether a shot needs a start keyframe, per shot, deterministically, with the reason journaled

rules.title: Video follows a selected keyframe
rules.statement: Every keyframe shot generates the policy's candidate count per attempt and promotes one by score; a winner under the selection floor is promoted with a named shortfall once candidate attempts are spent.
